sources.note: Programme page: fellowships in various fields of study; points to the China Scholarship Council site for the universities and fields; names no university or field
Application Guidelines 2026-2027: section 4 sends candidates to the China Scholarship Council site for fields and universities

subject_rule: Not stated as open or limited: UNESCO says only 'various fields of study' at a selected number of Chinese universities, and refers candidates to the China Scholarship Council site for the fields and universities, which could not be read.
notes: No host universities or fields are recorded: neither UNESCO page names any, and the list they point to sits on the China Scholarship Council site, which answers automated requests with a browser check that was not bypassed.

Guidelines wording: seventy-five fellowships 'in various fields of study at undergraduate and postgraduate levels', of which twenty-seven vacancies open to new candidates; study is for a master's or doctoral degree (2 to 5 years) or a one-year Visiting Scholar programme, taught in English or Chinese depending on what the selected university offers.
not_stated: The fields of study or majors available
Whether the field of study is open or limited
